description: Search the data.gov.be open data catalogue (federal, regional and local Belgian publishers), via its official mirror on data.europa.eu. Returns dataset ids usable with datagov_get_dataset.

language.description: Preferred language for titles and descriptions (falls back to another Belgian language)

organization.description: Exact publisher name as returned by datagov_list_organizations, e.g. 'IWEPS'

rows.description: Maximum number of datasets to return

tags.description: Comma-separated keywords that must all be present, e.g. 'mobility,brussels'

name: datagov_search_datasets
